original_method: Map populated sockets/dies/NBIOs to IOHUB instances and decode group 7/struct 1; validate errortype 0; document why threshold count changes FF5 to FFE and capture raw before value; establish Linux or Windows-specific evidence; inject once on one approved instance; correlate exact MCA bank/status/address or PCIe section and corrected count; verify no reset, sync flood or device degradation; restore threshold, NBIO, FCH and HDT state.
manual_activity: The FAE approves the IOHUB structure map, errortype and threshold change, applies BIOS/HDT state, performs one injection, diagnoses any escalation and restores raw threshold/RAS configuration.
required_inputs: Platform socket/die/NBIO-to-IOHUB-instance coverage and meaning of groupid 7/structid 1
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and proof errortype 0 selects the intended correctable parity source
Definition, width and raw before/target/restore values for MCA threshold count FF5 to FFE plus why deviation is required
Expected MCA bank/status/severity/source fields, corrected count delta and no-reset/service-health oracle
Separate supported Linux dmesg/APEI/rasdaemon and Windows WHEA collection method
Exact timeout, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and full BIOS/HDT restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with OOB console and known-good recovery path
Capture raw threshold and NBIO/FCH settings before writes; modify only documented fields
Inject one event on one mapped IOHUB and capture counters before any second action

No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff threshold, Platform First, NBIO, FCH and HDT state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The fixed IOHUB/group/structure tuple has no platform mapping and errortype 0 lacks cited semantics. FF5-to-FFE threshold meaning/rationale and restoration are absent; exact CE MCA signature and Windows method are unspecified; timeout and RDIMM relevance are unclear. DeepSeek's broad logs cannot resolve these gaps.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The IOHUB correctable parity intent is clear. Vendor mapping and threshold/evidence inputs can gate execution, so static review completes.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 69 Wistron-System RAS-00789-V002: map socket/die/NBIO to IOHUB instances and decode groupid 7/structid 1; prove errortype=0 correctable parity semantics; define MCA threshold FF5/FFE encoding, before/target/restore and rationale; specify exact CE MCA/APEI/WHEA source/status/count plus no-reset oracle for each supported OS, timeout, aborts, OOB recovery, RDIMM relevance and restoration.

review_improvement: Adds IOHUB structure attribution, raw threshold control and an exact corrected-MCA/no-reset oracle, avoiding acceptance based solely on tool PASS and generic parity text.
independent_technical_reasoning: IOHUB group and structure identifiers are implementation-specific, so a syntactically valid tuple can inject the wrong internal block. Threshold encoding may invert intuitive numeric meaning; FF5 to FFE cannot be interpreted safely without register documentation. Correctable acceptance requires one new corrected bank/count event with continued service, not merely the absence of a crash.
